object_dispositions.evidence_and_scope: `learning-blocks/perspective/manifest.yaml` specifies observation/interpretation/limitation and 2–4 items. GR03 provides meaningful markup, but the block is a manifest/markup contract rather than a separately demonstrated configurable renderer. Align item-count/interface claims with the interaction and declare assembly ownership before a second case. No need to merge it with an evidence ledger.

`interactions/labeled-graphic/labeled-graphic.js`: 423 GR03 checks and native 200% attestation support the bounded flow. Global selectors, fixed “all three” strings, GR03-specific interpretation selectors, DOM completion and preview-complete query parameters limit reuse. Specify host scope/count labels, responsive adapter responsibilities and preview/state policy before assessed or multi-instance reuse.

`compositions/perspective/` and GR03 responsive/image-failure evidence demonstrate a distinct scene/pane → stacked disclosure arrangement. Preserve this specialization. Document where collision/panel-move behavior is delegated to the interaction; a second independent situation/asset remains unproven.

Registered in `registries/patterns.json`; primary role and sequence are in GR03's frozen contract. No standalone owned pattern guide/manifest equivalent to the later patterns was identified. Materialize its general evidence-to-bounded-interpretation logic and explicit scope, separate from a particular labeled-graphic implementation.

Registered supporting pattern in GR03. Define perspective-taking as a lens on interpretation with compatible uses/limitations; distinguish it from the primary interpretation sequence. Do not merge merely because both currently appear on one screen; do not count two independent validated experiences.

`docs/patterns/build-repair/README.md` is a pedagogical contract, not renderer instructions. GR05 V05/V25 architectural/HRBA review is reported PASS; authored repair, preserved history, connected revision and unresolved follow-up are demonstrated. Approval review should be bounded to this learning pattern; cross-course effectiveness and integrated assessment are not established.

`learning-blocks/work-artifact/work-artifact.js` owns plain-text fields, links, comparisons and export without completion/storage authority; GR06 reuses its field/rubric helpers. Generic DOM/field/rubric primitives live inside a semantic artifact block and are imported by a template. Separate lower-level primitives when approving the interface, preserve repair-specific representation and test complete export.

`interactions/build-repair/model.js` owns D/A/R1/C/R2/F correctly; 31 model checks, 321 browser/stress and 84 keyboard/resilience checks support the frozen case. Connected-field predicates hard-code participation/accountability/evidence; controller labels include HRBA case assumptions and mojibake. Correct encoding and either declare a supported field-role contract or configure mappings before generalized use. Do not replace it with the evidence-decision reducer.

`compositions/repair-studio/repair-studio.css` owns layout only; stacking and paired comparison work with long authored content. Similar scaffolding in GR06 is a future shared-layout primitive opportunity. It is not a reason to use repair composition as the semantic identity of every workspace.

Default body/labels preserved; opt-in GR06 configuration has exact GR05 DOM/settled-render evidence. It arranges slots rather than being a full assembly engine. Unknown variant currently falls through to repair default; primitive import points upward into work-artifact. Validate supported variant/configuration and lower-level dependencies before further consumers. Keep exact defaults as regression fences.

`state/learning-state/learning-state.js` is unchanged across GR05/06, with 17 generic service checks, 16 GR06 adapter checks and browser restart/conflict evidence. It owns envelope/tier validation, truthful receipts, conflicts, clear and generic copy/download helpers; activity callbacks own completion. Approval review should be scoped to single-device browser drafts and documented degraded storage. No cloud sync, secure assessment authority, guaranteed erasure or multi-user collaboration is implied.

`learning-blocks/evidence-ledger/evidence-ledger.js` now owns source metadata/notes, typed informing/limiting and role links, paired records and export. Correct semantic specialization relative to repair artifacts. GR06 structural/plain-text/max-content evidence is strong; direct reader/zoom/mobile and independent semantic review remain pending. Its current case bounds need a declared supported-contract scope before new cases.

`interactions/evidence-decision/model.js` owns E/I/D/U/A/R/F, immutable capture, release, adaptation and invalidation; four routes are structurally completable and cosmetic/overclaiming negatives are not falsely scored. 72 model and 336 browser checks plus recovery evidence support the prototype, not semantic competence. Validate all contract-derived bounds/configuration before extending; complete pending direct/H01–H09 review before approval consideration.

`docs/patterns/evidence-decision/README.md` appropriately defines evidence, differentiated interpretation, decision/authority, update and review pedagogy. Four substantive fixtures and five negative counterexamples exist separately from runtime. Their independent H01–H09 judgment is pending, and no second context is demonstrated.

Existing GR04 default remains exactly locked and unchanged. The GR06 `source-interpretation-decision-update` opt-in CSS is arrangement-only and registered without a new ID. Retain variant as prototype pending GR06 direct review; protect default selectors/markup. Consolidate only repeated neutral layout scaffolding if justified, never GR04 decision behavior or the two semantic patterns.
